definitions.SALES_VOLUME: Net CO payment dollars after SYS_HASH dedupe, refunds signed negative, tips/change excluded, lines over $10k dropped. Legacy and unmapped shops excluded.
definitions.TRANSACTION_COUNT: Count of CO payment lines after SYS_HASH dedupe. Split tenders = multiple lines.
definitions.ORDER_COUNT: Distinct ORDER_ID (guest checks) on included payment lines.
definitions.AVG_TICKET: SALES_VOLUME ÷ ORDER_COUNT. Not Worldpay avg auth. Not card-only.
definitions.Gift Card / Dutch Pass: PAYMENT_TYPE IN (GIFT, CUSTOM). CUSTOM = Dutch Pass (loyalty app / digital wallet at the window).
definitions.mix_rule: Card + Cash + Gift Card / Dutch Pass pct_of_total_sales = 100.0 each week.

methodology.title: In-shop sales — data notes
methodology.audience: Dashboard and static chatbot. Do not treat this as Worldpay settlement.

source.join: STAND_NUMBER = mapping column B labeled NewCoID #. File headers are swapped vs values; column B holds stand codes such as CA2909. Keep Legacy/CO = CO only.

time.grain: Completed Monday–Sunday weeks only (ISO week Monday start).
time.date_field: BUSINESS_DATE (shop business day, not auth timestamp).

kpi_definitions.SALES_VOLUME: Net CO payment dollars. Tips and change excluded. Refunds signed negative. Lines with absolute amount > $10,000 dropped. CHECK and UNKNOWN excluded from mix.
kpi_definitions.TRANSACTION_COUNT: Count of payment lines after SYS_HASH dedupe. Split tenders (card+cash on one check) count as multiple lines. Not a guest-check count.
kpi_definitions.ORDER_COUNT: Count of distinct ORDER_ID on included payment lines. One guest check = one order even if paid with two tenders.
kpi_definitions.AVG_TICKET: SALES_VOLUME ÷ ORDER_COUNT (per order). Weeks extracted before this change used payment lines as the denominator — see AVG_TICKET_BASIS on each week.
kpi_definitions.Card: PAYMENT_TYPE = CREDIT. Includes Visa/MC/Amex/Discover when CREDIT_CARD_TYPE is populated. Not split to debit vs credit.
kpi_definitions.Gift Card / Dutch Pass: PAYMENT_TYPE IN (GIFT, CUSTOM). CUSTOM is Dutch Pass (loyalty app / wallet scan at the window). components.GIFT vs components.CUSTOM splits that bucket.
kpi_definitions.mix_rule: Card + Cash + Gift Card / Dutch Pass pct_of_total_sales = 100.0 each week (1 decimal, largest-remainder).

included_filters: RECORD_SUBTYPE = payment (or null treated as payment)
PAYMENT_TYPE in CASH, CREDIT, GIFT, CUSTOM
Non-null ITEM_AMOUNT_TOTAL, non-blank PAYMENT_TYPE and STAND_NUMBER
exclusions: Shops not in the company-operated mapping
RECORD_SUBTYPE = tip (not company drink sales; card networks still authorize sale+tip)
RECORD_SUBTYPE = change (cash handed back, not sales)
Non-payment record types (item, tax, discount, modifiers, deleted_item)

xenial_columns_used.BUSINESS_DATE: Shop business date for the week bucket.
xenial_columns_used.STAND_NAME: Present on the table (e.g. DB1242); not used in the KPI join.
xenial_columns_used.ORDER_ID: Guest check id. AVG_TICKET denominator. Do not dedupe the extract on ORDER_ID (split tenders).
xenial_columns_used.SYS_HASH: Line identity for dedupe. Xenial TRANSACTION_ID is not unique across shops.
xenial_columns_used.ORDER_NUMBER: On the table; not used in this KPI.
xenial_columns_used.RECORD_TYPE: Must be payment for sales mix.
xenial_columns_used.RECORD_SUBTYPE: payment = sales tender; tip and change excluded.
xenial_columns_used.PAYMENT_TYPE: CASH / CREDIT / GIFT / CUSTOM / CHECK / UNKNOWN.
xenial_columns_used.TRANSACTION_TYPE: REFUND signed as negative; other values kept as-is (typically SALE).
xenial_columns_used.ITEM_AMOUNT_TOTAL: Tender amount on that payment line.
xenial_columns_used.CREDIT_CARD_TYPE: Visa/MC/Amex/Discover when present; not in the current mix JSON. Blank on many CREDIT rows.
xenial_columns_used.TRANSACTION_ID: Not used for dedupe (repeats across shops, e.g. 2573).

xenial_columns_on_table_not_in_kpi.ITEM_NAME / MAJOR_CATEGORY / MINOR_CATEG: Product mix — item grain, not tender mix.
xenial_columns_on_table_not_in_kpi.TAXES__TOTAL_EXCLUSIVE / TAXES__TOTAL_IN: Tax. Whether finance 'sales' is pre-tax is TBD.
xenial_columns_on_table_not_in_kpi.DISCOUNT_CODE and discount records: Promos; last full week ~$8.5M company-wide item+order discounts (all shops).

clarifications: This is POS tender mix, not Worldpay settlement. Worldpay auth summaries are card-network auths (often sale+tip), all shops on that chain/MID, approved purchases, integer dollars.
Worldpay prior-week file 2026-08-17: approved purchases $28.1M, 2.32M auths, avg $12.15. POS CO all-tender avg ~$10 and POS credit+tip ~$11.72 are different metrics — do not force them equal.
AVG_TICKET is not a Worldpay average ticket and is not card-only.
Tips belong in a Worldpay recon metric, not in SALES_VOLUME.
Change must stay out of sales.
Mapping column labels Shop Number vs NewCoID # do not match the values in the file; join on column B = STAND_NUMBER.
Dutch Pass is CUSTOM, folded into Gift Card / Dutch Pass so Card+Cash+Gift mix = 100%.
assumptions: Shop_Type_Mapping.xlsx is the authority for CO vs Legacy.
The $10k drop applies to any payment line over $10k absolute, not cash-only (original note said cash; three dropped rows were large cash-like amounts).
CREDIT is one Card bucket (no debit split).
No other wallet tender besides CUSTOM/Dutch Pass is mapped in this feed.
Worldpay chain 0OS957 shop list vs CO mapping is not confirmed equal.

sample_window_notes_all_shops_2026_08_10.note: Those window notes are company-wide Xenial, not CO-only, for context vs Worldpay.
